insight: Released under the Functional Source License (FSL) — source-available at launch and converting to MIT open-source after two years.
name: Crush
tagline: Charm's glamorous agentic AI coding agent for your terminal.
description: A terminal-based AI coding agent from Charm, the team behind Bubble Tea and other CLI tools. It plans and edits files, runs commands, and pulls code context via LSP, all inside a polished TUI. It is model-agnostic: bring your own keys for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Groq, OpenRouter, and other providers, and switch models mid-session.

modelSupport.notes: Bring your own API keys; supports many providers and custom OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

edge: Charm's signature TUI polish over a model-agnostic terminal agent: switch providers mid-session and keep code, keys, and data on your own machine.
pros: Runs locally; you control keys and data
cons: Requires your own model API keys
FSL license is not OSI open-source yet
